title: cyclobalanopsis × takaoyamensis
intro: Cyclobalanopsis × takaoyamensis, commonly known as the Takaoyamensis oak, is a hybrid plant species within the Quercus genus, resulting from the cross between Cyclobalanopsis glauca and Quercus serrata. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Takaoyamensis oak are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential to mitigate oxidative stress and inflammation.
